edits.old:
# Blur specific region (coordinates x:y:w:h)
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "boxblur=10:5:x=100:y=100:w=200:h=200" output.mp4
edits.new:
# Blur specific region (coordinates x:y:w:h) using crop+blur+overlay
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]split[base][tmp];[tmp]crop=w=200:h=200:x=100:y=100,boxblur=10:5[blur];[base][blur]overlay=x=100:y=100" output.mp4
